title: Payment step 3 — polling: the Hub leg is executing
description: The intermediate states are QUOTING, BRIDGE_IN_PROGRESS, SWAP_IN_PROGRESS and BRIDGE_OUT_PROGRESS. Fields appear as the orchestration reaches them: the swap hash is present, the bridge-out position is not yet.
notes: Gateway: Banco de San Jose commercial-bank gateway, spoke-crc. Poll until COMPLETED or FAILED. Spec gap: that status vocabulary is not in the platform OpenAPI document at all — it is recovered from Go domain code, which is why contracts/amm publishes status as a plain string rather than an enum the vendor has not committed to. Everything except swap_id, correlation_id, status and created_at is conditional on progress; a client must tolerate their absence.
